english.title: Producer or authorised representative fail to become member of new scheme when old scheme withdrawn

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer]_

who was a member of a scheme approved by the relevant appropriate relevant authority under regulation 55 of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 and had been notified that approval of that scheme had been withdrawn under regulation 58(1) of those regulations, failed within 28 days of **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT DATE..), being the date of notification being served on you by the appropriate authority under regulation 58(3) of the regulations, to become a member of a new scheme or notify the authority of your intention to become a member of a proposed scheme which was the subject of an application for approval made under regulation 55(2)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(9), 90(1)(b)(i) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a producer / authorised representative
who was a member of a scheme and been notified that it had been withdrawn
failed within 28 days of service to become a member of a new scheme or notify authority of intention to join proposed scheme subject to an application for approval

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:

Indictment: A fine
